name: Weather
reason: Folks, we've got a warm, nearly dry late-July week with highs averaging 27.2C and just 1.7 mm of rain, which sets a decent stage for algae, but with only one day topping the hot threshold it's not the full-blown heat dome a bloom loves.
evidence: Average max temperature of 27.2C is warm but below the 30C bloom-boosting mark
Only 1 hot day this week, so sustained heat is limited
Rain total of just 1.7 mm means little mixing or flushing of the lake
Late July timing is peak season for warm, stratified water
